note: Autos, industrial electricals, chemicals, insurance — an export-industrial index with one software giant. Energy and payments leave the table entirely, because Frankfurt lists neither: there is no German oil major, and the payments sector did not survive Wirecard as a listed pure play. The energy transition is observed here through electrical equipment and utilities. There is no listed German data-centre operator, so the AI build-out is observed through electrical equipment and utilities rather than through a theme of its own.
